question: For the Toggle MFA post-pod action, which pod identity configurations are eligible, and is IDM supported?

result.question: For the Toggle MFA post-pod action, which pod identity configurations are eligible, and is IDM supported?
result.answer:
Before you start, note these restrictions from the cited documentation:
> 1. PipelineHub will have a post pod action Enable/Disable MFA and based on the user choice the post pod action will call the corresponding JC's on the IdentityService or IdentityService/ManagedDatabase pods only , this feature is not available for IDM and the UI should not show this feature for IDM PODs. [doc-0098]

Documented guidance:
- The Toggle MFA post-pod action is available only for IdentityService and IdentityService/ManagedDatabase pods. [doc-0098]
- The Toggle MFA feature is explicitly not available for IDM, and the UI must not display this option for IDM pods. [doc-0098]
- When MFA is disabled, users can log in to IdentityService and IdentityService/ManagedDatabase pods using only a username and password. [doc-0098]
- If MFA is enabled, users are prompted for extra authentication to log in to the eligible pods. [doc-0098]
- BuildAcceptanceTests automatically disable MFA on the pod during their run, as these tests cannot execute with MFA enabled. [doc-0098]

Sources:
- [doc-0098] PipelineHub Preflight - Post Pod Actions - Toggle MFA

Links, commands, and configurations in this adapted documentation are illustrative.

retrieved_sources.title: PipelineHub Preflight - Post Pod Actions - Toggle MFA
retrieved_sources.text:
Toggle MFA (Multi-Factor Authentication) 

1. PipelineHub will have a post pod action Enable/Disable MFA and based on the user choice the post pod action will call the corresponding JC's on the IdentityService or IdentityService/ManagedDatabase pods only , this feature is not available for IDM and the UI should not show this feature for IDM PODs.
2. if MFA is disabled then the users will be able to login with user name and password on the IdentityService and IdentityService/ManagedDatabase pods
3. if the MFA is enabled user will be prompted for extra authentication to be able to login to the PODs
4. if BuildAcceptanceTests are triggered, BuildAcceptanceTests will automatically disable the MFA on the POD as BuildAcceptanceTests cannot run with MFA on, so when BuildAcceptanceTests are triggered the assumption is that MFA will be disabled (this will be done during the BuildAcceptanceTests run) , irrespective of what the user has done during prov or post prov action.

Eligible PODS (IdentityService) will have the option in the post pod actions - TOGGLE MFA

The user will be able to ENABLE MFA or DISABLE MFA based on the option selected (true or false)

retrieved_sources.text:
Redcontent moved to DocumentationPortal <https://docs.example.com/reference/resource-671>

Support Data Masking as post pod action
---------------------------------------

We have support for data masking as a post pod action.Data Masking is used for hiding PII data and for masking the fields in DB according to the DM template ingested while creation of the release.This is only applicable on non prod type pods.The Pod to be used for data masking should be with a version at least 11.13.24.10.0-11000 or above.

**Note:**

* Data masking will work for the releases for which DM template is already ingested.(Ex:GA,HWM ).

**Feature not yet supported:**

* Multiple data masking runs.

More details on Data Making: <https://docs.example.com/reference/resource-399>

**Data Masking Oneoff Job:**

For cases where the data masking is timed out ,there will be a replay shown for status check of the data masking.

ManagedDatabase Enabled Flag

this is a requirement for LifecycleManager to be able to use PipelineHub for ADBS prov

Support Enabled DB info check box for EnvironmentService provisioning

PipelineHub now support with "Enabled DB info" check box feature for EnvironmentService provisioning which works exactly like GEN1.

 

X86 is defaulted for provisioning, ARM Pods are based on user selection 

X86 is now the default for POD provisioning. User should click "***Provision an ARM64 pod***" if they want an ARM pod.  

#### All Pods Dashboard Enhancements

The All Pods Dashboard has been revamped, improving performance and add more filters similar to Family Pods Dashboard, to have a consistent look and feel.

### Multitenant UI Enhancements

Note - Multi Tenant Related features are currently restricted to super admins

* Support for multiple data planes associated with a Proxy Service
* Multi Tenant Preflight dashboard enhancements displaying services selected for promotion and environment details

retrieved_sources.title: PipelineHub Preflight - Special Project
retrieved_sources.text:
### Special Project Support for Provisioning

Users can now choose to provision a pod using a valid registered special project.

Note - All ENV/PODs created using special projects will not be eligible for regular promotion preflights.

1. Check 'Enable Special Project'
2. From the drop down select available active special project
3. The 'BusinessApp Release' will fetch the registered release sets that belong to this special project - choose appropriate release set
4. And the rest of the options like cloudnative / overrides remain the same
5. Once all the options are selected, user can submit preflights

Once the preflight is successful - the reporting page should show the special project details with project name (under purpose)

### HWM Template Support for Special Project

PipelineHub will now allow HWM Templates to be used for Special Project Provisioning. 

### Special Project Support for  EnvironmentService Upgrade

PipelineHub now support EnvironmentService upgrade for special project.
